summary: An oversight inquiry finds that two agencies can describe their yearly jobs without pointing to a written division of responsibility.
realLife: GAO found that Treasury and IRS had documented their special 2018 analysis but lacked written assignments for the ordinary annual withholding table update.
inGame: needs: an audit distinguishes a one-year analysis from recurring duties.
gates: An audit distinguishes a one-year analysis from recurring duties.

turns.what: The next reviewer knows where to request the signoff.
turns.pulledBy: The agencies assign a recurring owner in writing.
turns.writesBack: The oversight file links the dated assignment.

turns.what: The auditor keeps the recurring-duty question open.
turns.pulledBy: The agencies supply only the exceptional year's memo.
